notFound: UK retail prices: tcl.com/uk shows no prices (its Buy now button is a retailer widget) and Currys (Cloudflare 403), Argos (403), John Lewis (connection error), AO (Cloudflare challenge) and Harvey Norman UK (403) could not be opened, so UK offers are the 38 Appliances Direct selling prices from its two-page TCL listing (the selling price in its page's structured data; any was-price was not read) plus Richer Sounds 65C7K-UK at 799 GBP (shown out of stock), and about 95 of the 135 UK-listed models still have no price.

UK offers from Argos and Costco UK for 55P8K-UK (449.00 and 449.98 GBP) are marked secondhand because those retailer pages were not opened here, only reported in a web search result (Costco UK's own page renders its price client-side and showed none in the HTML).

Ireland retail prices: Harvey Norman IE returned 403 to every fetch, so its three offers (65T8C recorded at the 749 EUR RRP although the search result showed 699 current, 65P8L at 849, 65C8L at 1,999) are marked secondhand, DID Electrical's TCL collection returned no products, and tcl.com/ie shows no prices; the ten Tommie Kelly Euronics offers are read from its own TCL brand page.

Mexico retail prices: only the first Liverpool results page for 'tcl' was read (27 first-party TV offers; 8 listings sold by third-party sellers were skipped), Coppel and Walmart Mexico were not fetched, and tcl.com/mx shows no prices, so most of the 99 Mexican maker-listed models have no offer.
US retail: only the maker store us.tcl.com was read (64 sizes), Best Buy US and Walmart were not fetched, so no US retailer offers are recorded.

Canada: ca-en.tcl.com marks every item unavailable, so its 29 offers are listed prices only; 20 of its SKUs whose compare-at price is below the price (for example 43Q651G-CA and 115QM891G) were skipped as inconsistent, SKUs priced 0.00 (the QM64L, M8L, Q6L and P8L lines and 65QM6K) have no price, and its legacy 2021-2024 Roku/Android/S-class SKUs were only used where the model was already in the catalog.

Best Buy Canada was read through its own search API for 'tcl tv' (4 pages, 343 results, 84 first-party TVs kept); 14 marketplace-seller or open-box listings were skipped and any TCL TV the API did not return for that query is missing.

Price convention: where a page shows a struck-through list price beside a lower current price (us.tcl.com, ca-en.tcl.com, Best Buy Canada, Liverpool) the struck-through regular price is recorded as the brief asks, so current selling prices are lower, for example 55QM6K is 649.99 USD regular against 549.99 now at us.tcl.com and 43Q6K is 10,599 MXN regular against 5,998.80 now at Liverpool.

On-mode watts: no US, Canadian or Mexican page states them (the us.tcl.com spec table gives only standby power), so onModeWatts exists only for models with an EU/UK energy-label entry that was read: the EPREL registry list API (TCL entries newest first, 11 pages covering market dates 2025-03-21 to 2026-10-02) plus the 75P6K-UK fiche PDF, with the matched identifier named in powerBasis and EPREL's qr page in powerUrl.

Energy-label wattage is missing for models whose EPREL entries are older than 2025-03-21 or were not read: C655K, C805K, C855K, Q9BK, P755K, V6BK, PF650K and 115X955K, UK P8K-UK (55/65/75), 55Q7C-UK, C6KS-UK (55/65/75), P6K-UK (55/65), V6C-UK (65/75); nine of these still carry the EPREL number linked on tcl.com.

refreshHz is null for 157 models because no maker or retailer page read states a refresh rate, and the EPREL 'image refresh frequency rate (default)' was used only when every registered version declares 60 Hz, since it understates native 144 Hz panels (C7K-UK shows 120 there against 144 on the maker page).

year is the model year printed in a Best Buy Canada or Harvey Norman IE page title, the 2026 in the us.tcl.com A300L product title, otherwise the first EU on-market date from EPREL, otherwise the tcl.com/uk page release year; it stays null for models with none of these, and tcl.com/ie and tcl.com/mx page dates were not used because they run later than the model year (QM6K is dated 2026 on tcl.com/mx but 2025 at Best Buy Canada).

Models still listed on tcl.com/uk or tcl.com/ie but released before 2024 (S5200K, S5209K, S5400AK, S5400AFK, SF540K, ES568, C635K, C645K, C735K, C745K, C825K, C835K, C845K, C935K, P638K, P725K, P735K, P745K) and tcl.com/mx's S3A, QM850G and S450G pages were left out because no 2025-2026 sale could be confirmed.

UK/EU codes (C7K, C8L, P8L and so on) and US QM-series codes (QM7K, QM8L) were not linked as the same product because no maker page states they are equivalent; only identical base codes ignoring the -UK and -CA suffixes were merged, and the EU/UK energy-label wattage on a US-coded model is that of the EU/UK-market version of the same code.

No OLED, QD-OLED, MicroLED or 8K TCL television appeared on any maker listing read, and smartOs, panel or resolution stay null where the maker's or retailer's text did not state them (54 models lack smartOs, mostly UK/IE/MX listings that name no platform).
